content.title: Solo Ball - Men's Basketball - University of Connecticut Athletics
content.text: 2025-26 (as a junior): Appeared and started in 39 of 40 games… averaged 12.8 points and connected on 77 threes (tied for team-lead)… All-BIG EAST Second Team Selection… Jerry West Award Finalist… NABC All-District First Team pick… ranked second in the BIG EAST in free throw percentage with an 85.1 percent mark…led the Huskies in scoring 11 times,recording 24 double-figure scoring games… scored 23 points in a win over Columbia (Nov. 10)… poured in 19 points, connecting on three triples vs. No. 18 Florida in the Jimmy V Classic… notched a career-high 26 points against Butler (Dec. 16)…chipped in 24 points and five three-pointers against Villanova (Jan. 24)…poured in 24 points and a season-high six threes at Butler (Feb. 11)…had 20 points, connecting on five threes against Georgetown (Feb. 14)… named BIG EAST Player of the Week on Feb. 15… scored 19 points in BIG EAST Quarterfinal win over Xavier (March 12)…scored 13 points, drilling three threes in Final Four win over Illinois (April 4). 2024-25 (as a sophomore): Had a breakout campaign that netted Second Team All-BIG EAST honors…was an NABC All-District First Team pick...increased his scoring average by more than four times, going from 3.1 points per game as a rookie to 14.4 in 2024-25…was the lone Husky to start all 35 contests and was second on the team with 31.7 minutes a night…emerged as one of the nation’s top 3-point shooters, ranking top-30 in the country and first in the BIG EAST with a 41.4 percent mark from 3-point range…505 total points were the 10th most for a sophomore in UConn history…added 3.6 rebounds and 1.6 assists per contest, while totaling 26 steals and 13 blocks…shot 43.9 percent from the floor and 84.1 percent from the free throw line while recording a 1.6 assist/turnover ratio…had a pair of double-doubles, the first two of his career…hit seven 3-pointers in a game twice (Jan. 1 at DePaul and Feb. 1 at Marquette), tied for the fifth-most in a game by a player in program history…in the Feb. 1 game at MU, set career-highs with 25 points and 11 rebounds…totaled six 20-point games and scored in double-figures 32 times 2023-24 (as a freshman): Appeared in 39 games, making 10 starts from Nov. 14 – Dec. 20...-named BIG EAST Freshman of the Week on Dec. 7...averaged 3.3 points and 1.0 rebounds in 11.5 minutes per game...shot 38.5 percent from the floor and 31.9 percent from 3-point range...scored a career-high 13 points on 5-of-8 shooting from the floor and 3-of-6 shooting from deep in the Jimmy V Classic against No. 9 North Carolina on Dec...also scored in double-figures against MVSU (Nov. 14) at Xavier (Jan. 28) Before UConn: Comes to UConn after an outstanding high school career, spending his senior year at Brewster Academy (Wolfeboro, N.H.) and the two previous years at St. James School (Hagerstown, Md.)… Consensus Top 60 recruit…as a senior at Brewster Academy, he averaged 16.3 points, 4.6 rebounds, 1.4 assists per game and shot .529 overall and .842 from the foul line… He was named First Team All-NEPSAC Class AAA , First Team All-American (NextUpRecruits.net), was an Iverson Classic Selection and a nomi-nee for McDonald’s All-American… As a junior at St. James School, averaged 25.4 points, 5.3 rebounds, 2.8 assists per game… Also played for Team Melo on AAU circuit – averaged 17.8 points, 5.5 rebounds, 1.3 assists and shot 57.0 percent overall for Nike EYBL Indianapolis and 14.8 points, 4.4 rebounds, 1.4 assists and 1.6 steals in five games for Nike EYBL Louisville… Played alongside current UConn teammates Jayden and Jacob Ross at St. James School. Personal Information: Solomon Armstead Ball… Born Dec. 7, 2003... Son of Erica and Mike Ball… Has one older brother, Zion, and two older sisters, London and Milan.
